raw_text: `content/` bilingual; sibling `_index.de.md`/`_index.en.md` mirrored front matter. Extend `layouts/partials/`/`layouts/shortcodes/`; never edit `themes/hugo-theme-relearn`. CSS `assets/css/theme-grafioschtrader.css`; pass-through `static/`; refresh `public/`/`resources/` only via `hugo --cleanDestinationDir`. Hugo Extended v0.120+; lowercase domain folders/files; nearby media/diagrams; existing shortcodes; Markdown headings/lists/tables. Run `hugo --gc --minify --printI18nWarnings` before every commit; today that build is the test suite. Add `--i18n-warnings --printUnusedTranslations --printPathWarnings`. Preview `hugo server --disableFastRender -D --buildFuture --navigateToChanged`; deploy `hugo --gc --minify --printI18nWarnings --cleanDestinationDir`; snapshots `hugo server --renderToDisk --printUnusedTemplates`. Spot-check `public/search/index.json`/HTML in Chromium/Firefox. Focused imperative commits; include regenerated `public/`. PRs list paths/issues, screenshots/zipped previews, and state whether `hugo --gc --minify` ran clean.
